name: Geometric Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker
specs:
Geometric Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker

Geometric Ginza Stone Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker Be part of the first chapter in an exciting collaboration between Urban Bar and InkedOz with this exclusive Geometric Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker, available only through the Urban Bar website. Created in partnership with Daniel “Oz” Osborne — known for sharing his bartending expertise online, leading training within hospitality, and championing both professional development and well-being in the industry — this special release celebrates craftsmanship, performance, and the culture of modern bartending. Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel, the Ginza Tin-on-Tin Cocktail Shaker set includes our Ginza Can and Ginza Cup. Its high-grade steel construction delivers a lighter, more robust finish than standard barware, while offering superior insulation for a colder, more effective shake. Favoured by professional mixologists, it also produces a satisfying rattle as the ice moves through the full steel body, adding a touch of theatre to every serve. A silver-welded base provides added strength, while the steel’s excellent corrosion resistance helps protect against rust for lasting durability. As the very first Urban Bar x InkedOz release, this is an exclusive collaboration piece designed for bartenders who take their craft seriously. Product Features: Professional dual shaker tin set Made from premium 18/8 Japanese steel for greater corrosion resistance Outlasts standard poor grade steel shakers Unique Tumbled Stone Finish Both tins are weighted on the base

name: Muddler Bar Spoon 28cm, 2.5ml & 5ml
specs:
Muddler Bar Spoon 28cm, 2.5ml & 5ml

The Muddler Bar Spoon was developed with award winning bartender Wayne Collins to give a multi-purpose bar tool. The double sided measuring head lets you measure both 5ml and 2.5ml. The tip is larger and more robust than standard flat end muddlers for far more effective muddling ability. Measure: The spoon is a double-sided measure, approx. 5ml/0.17oz in one side and approx. 2.5ml/0.08oz (a half spoon) in the reverse. It also gives a useful half measure (12.5ml) with 2x 5ml & 1x 2.5ml Perfect for precise mixology. Crushing: The tip of the spoon can be used to crush solid ingredients in the bottom of a glass or cocktail shaker. Stir/Soft Rotation: Push the spoon between thumb and finger to make the spoon head rotate and mix a drink, alternatively plunge with the flat end or simply stir. Layer/Float: Pour down the twisted shank keeping the flat end above the first spirit or hold the bowl end of the spoon in contact with the side of the glass and pour into it allowing the liquor to trickle down the side of the glass and on to the layer below. Product Features: Bar spoon with heavyweight end Double sided head for small measures - 2.5ml and 5ml (approx.) Gives refined measuring for cocktail making Twisted stem for layering - twist is wider than standard spoons for a more comfortable hold Made from 18/8 Japanese steel Lightweight and strong High resistance to corrosion and rusting Dishwasher safe - see our Steel Care Guide page for more information Please Note: For tougher muddling, please browse our Cocktail Muddlers .

Yansheng Tin-on-Tin Copper Plated Weighted Shaker 85cl

This tin on tin shaker is made with a classic Asian shape featuring a premium copper finish giving a slightly heavier, more robust shaker. Made with our standard high level of quality steel and featuring laser welded caps on the base of the two tins. Yansheng Coins are talismans of good fortune in China, and often used to bring in money in Feng Shui. These coins are round with a square hole in the centre. They represent both heaven (the circle) and earth (the square), and because of this, they are deemed especially auspicious. name: Westwell Pelegrim NV  -  75cl
specs:
Westwell Pelegrim NV  -  75cl

This crisp, mouthwatering English bubbly is an ode to the pelegrims (or pilgrims as we call them today) that have walked along the Pilgrims Way, which goes right past the vineyard, for several centuries. This classic cuvée is the essence of English sparkling wine: filled with aromas of wild strawberries and crisp green apples. With the classic trio of sparkling wine grapes - Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier - its an inviting, easy-drinking English bubbly from the excellent portfolio of Westwell made by former music producer Adrian Pike. Serving Suggestions Serve well chilled in a sparkling wine flute. This is a bright and refreshing sparkling wine with a pleasing, easy-to-enjoy finish that makes a great aperitivo to be served early in the evening or with weekend brunch. If you fancy trying your hand at a sparkling cocktail with this, take an English spin on the French 75 (a Soixante Quinze ): chill some gin in a cocktail shaker with ice, a splash of syrup and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Strain it into your wine flute, pour over a glass of chilled Westwell Pelegrim and garnish with a lemon peel. Perfect for a party! Tasting Notes Poised and refreshing, this is a very English bubbly with aromas of cider apples, lemon sherbet, spring blossoms and wild strawberries with notes of sourdough bread from three years ageing on the lees.

specs:

With a perforated head, this cocktail spoon allows easy drainage of ice cubes and other wet ingredients to drain excess liquid. name: Classic Stainless Steel Bar Spoon 27cm — No Engraving
specs:
Classic Stainless Steel Bar Spoon 27cm — No Engraving

The Classic Bar Spoon is an essential of any bar kit. A great all round tool, this spoon allows you to stir, gently muddle and layer drinks. Urban Bar have enhanced this basic tool by making it from high grade 18/8 Japanese steel. This premium material give the spoon a luxury polished finish, perfect for mixology display. In addition, this spoon has a high level of corrosion resistance, ensuring it outlasts other basic steel bar tools. Using the standard European bar spoon design, this bar tool has a classic twisted stem with a flat disc on the end. The twisted stem is a standard on most bar spoons, giving lots of curves for drinks to flow around during stirring. The corkscrew shape also allows more controlled pouring with a channel perfect for accepting liquid from a free-flow pourer . Because of this, the liquors that flow down the spiral land neatly on the flat disc, allowing them to gently spread. The flat disc can also be used for gentle bruising of ingredients such as sugar cubes or soft fruit. name: Classic Gold Bar Spoon 27cm — No Engraving
specs:
Classic Gold Bar Spoon 27cm — No Engraving

This stunning gold bar spoon makes your mixology stand out in a dark bar setting. The classic European design features a twisted stem and a flat disc end. The corkscrew stem helps you get the best mix while stirring. The shape lets you roll the spoon between your fingers while stirring to rotate the head as it stirs your drink. Also, this twist allows you to pour liquors down the shaft of the spoon to help make layered cocktails. The classic flat disc on the end of this gold bar spoon turns it in to a gentle muddler. Crush soft ingredients such as sugar cubes or soft fruits to release the flavours before stirring. Using 18/8 Japanese steel, this gold bar spoon is made from the finest materials. This high grade stainless steel has a higher corrosion resistance than standard steel barware. This gives it better protection against rust for a longer lifespan. In addition, the premium material gives the spoon a high polished shine, which is reflected in the gold coating. The Gold Classic Bar Spoon has a coating of PVD titanium nitride, giving it the bold gold colouring. This coat also gives the spoon a toughened exterior, affording it higher abrasion and corrosion resistance. Whereas gold plating is likely to scratch, PVD gold coating is more durable. This gold bar spoon will far outlast gold plated bar tools. name: Barrel Wax 7ml
specs:
Barrel Wax 7ml

Made from Natural Beeswax, Barrel wax is used during the curing process for whisky ageing barrels. While curing a barrel should seal any natural gaps, a small amount of barrel wax is ideal for sealing up any further leaks. To help seal a leak in your oak barrel, rub the wax gently between your fingers until it softens; to apply simply press in to the gap. Our barrel wax is made from 100% natural beeswax, without any added synthetic oils or softeners. This is intentional, as it keeps the product food-safe, long-lasting, and suitable for use on wood that comes into contact with spirits. However, because it’s a completely natural material, its texture can vary more than a blended or petroleum-based wax. Beeswax naturally reacts to temperature changes during transport or storage. If it has been exposed to colder conditions, the wax crystals inside the beeswax can become firmer and more brittle, which can lead to a crumbly texture. Normally, gentle warming helps these crystals relax and return to a softer, more malleable state — but in some cases, if the wax has cooled too quickly or unevenly, it may not fully recover its smooth consistency.
